newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed marginally up on gains by blue chip shares, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 1.28 points or 0.1 percent at 1,228.3 on a turnover of 99.3 million taka on Sunday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. Losers led gainers by 70 to 59.
"The market opened mixed amid profit taking on some leather scrips, but later gained slightly on buying of select blue chips by small investors," said one broker.
Singer Bangladesh lost 102 taka to 6,733, Beximco Pharma gained 2.29 to 172.55 and Meghna Cement rose 29.49 to 734.89.
